gold_sql:
SELECT c.symbol_id, COUNT(*) AS methods
FROM code.symbols c
JOIN code.symbols m ON m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.kind = 'method'
  AND m.qualname = c.qualname || '.' || m.name
WHERE c.kind = 'class'
GROUP BY c.symbol_id
ORDER BY methods DESC, c.symbol_id
LIMIT 5;
